say:2:1123601002:1.text: We of the Grimmaw Clan are all about strength, so we focus heavily on training our warriors. We've never had mages among us, so we lack experience in dealing with them.
say:2:1123601002:1.source_cn: 黑嚎崇尚力量，重视战士的培养，从未有过魔法师，也因此缺...

say:3:1123601003:1.text: While you all are still here in Ashen Wastes, I'd like to ask for your help in <style="highlight">training these warriors</style>.

say:4:1123601004:1.text: Only by experiencing the power of magic will they stop taking mages lightly.
say:4:1123601004:1.source_cn: 只有切实体会过魔法的强大，他们才不会轻视身为魔法师的对手。
